goal_level: L3 station-radius GHSL population tile-routing correction gate
routing_rule: Use the mean origin derived from opened GHSL GeoTIFF bounds: north_origin=89.09958351, west_origin=-180.00791704, then assign R/C with floor((north_origin - latitude)/10)+1 and floor((longitude - west_origin)/10)+1 before applying the same 50 km draft buffer.

evidence_gate_counts.reader_use: Opened GeoTIFF bounds provide an empirical origin for R/C routing.
Derived origins should be nearly identical across opened tiles before rerouting the queue.
The corrected queue replaces the simple-grid queue for future HEAD/download work.
Retained rows keep any prior HEAD or checksum evidence attached.

evidence_gate_counts.gate: New corrected tile URLs needing custody
evidence_gate_counts.reader_use: Added rows need HEAD metadata, download feasibility, and checksums before catchment use.
Removed rows should not be used as population denominator tiles under the corrected origin.
No catchment population, PM2.5 exposure, or map is computed here.

origin_rows.reader_use: Use these rows to derive the corrected GHSL R/C tile-routing origin before selecting tiles for catchment work.
origin_rows.non_claim: This GHSL tile-routing correction gate derives an observed R/C grid origin from already downloaded GHSL GeoTIFF bounds, recomputes the station-coordinate tile queue with the same 50 km draft buffer, and records which selected tile IDs are retained, added, or removed. It does not download newly added tiles, retry HEAD probes, compute station-radius population, compute PM2.5 exposure, validate same-station joins, freeze radius or de-duplication rules, or promote monitor-grade rows.
